note: Forecast ledger, run only. Dated, falsifiable calls with a probability and a resolution date. The run adds one to three a week, never edits a call after it is made, resolves each on its date (yes, no, or void when the question stopped being meaningful) with the fact and source, and the page keeps a Brier score. Seed entries dated 7 Nov 2026 were made at the 7.0 build.

items.q: A trilateral Russia–Ukraine–US round is held in Abu Dhabi on 10 Nov with both delegations present
items.why: Putin named the date on 6 Nov and Ukraine named its delegation head.
items.note: Held: Ukrainian, Russian and US delegations met in Abu Dhabi on 10 Nov for four hours, Rustem Umerov leading Ukraine's team and Vladimir Medinsky Russia's, with Witkoff and Kushner mediating; a second day followed on 11 Nov. [6]
src: Ukraine, Russia, US conclude 1st day of peace talks in Abu Dhabi, discuss 'humanitarian, de-escalation steps'

items.q: The De Wever government is still in office on 30 Nov
items.why: The King has held the resignation in suspense and is consulting party leaders.

items.q: The FY27 NDAA conference report is filed in the House before 19 Dec
items.why: Both chambers have passed bills; the last three years' reports were filed between 6 and 14 Dec.

items.q: The House holds a recorded floor vote on Rep. Massie's impeachment resolution against Secretary Hegseth (to adopt, table or refer it) by 20 Nov
items.why: The resolution is privileged and must be scheduled within two legislative days of being offered, and the House minority leader backs it.

items.q: The Tweede Kamer passes the 2027 tax plan on 12 Nov
items.why: The coalition's 66 seats plus ChristenUnie, 50PLUS and the Markuszower group make a majority, per DutchNews on 5 Nov.

items.q: Russia and Ukraine complete a prisoner exchange of at least 1,000 people on each side by 3 Dec
items.why: Medinsky and Umerov announced agreement on a large-scale exchange on 11 Nov and TASS gave two to three weeks; the largest swap so far was 1,000 for 1,000 in May 2025.

items.q: The VVD still has ministers in the Dutch cabinet on 30 Nov
items.why: Yesilgöz threatened a fundamental reset over the D66–CDA tax deal on 11 Nov but did not announce a departure.

items.q: Israel carries out an acknowledged strike on Iranian territory by 15 Dec
items.why: Israeli media reported on 11 Nov that the security cabinet ordered strike preparations, while Netanyahu governs as caretaker and Eisenkot forms a government.
